validationMethodology: 80/20 Stratified Train/Test Split (N_train=4,256, N_test=1,064) + 5-Fold Stratified Cross-Validation
knownLimitations: Severe-class recall is 0 on the current held-out test partition; the model does not yet demonstrate reliable Severe-class discrimination.
Severe disaster events are naturally rare (N=19 total, 0.36% of observations across 5 zones).
Borderline Severe events are conservatively predicted as High risk by both Random Forest and XGBoost.
fallbackBehavior: When ML microservice is unreachable or times out, intelligenceService gracefully switches to the deterministic Heuristic Fallback Engine with isFallback=true.
